events.title: Case of beer
events.body: A case materializes behind a Subaru with Vermont plates. No one claims it. You claim it.

events.title: Burrito cooler
events.body: A cooler full of ice-cold veggie burritos appears like a mirage. Lot magic is real.

events.title: Shakedown Sally
events.body: You're way too high. Shakedown Sally talks fast and your wallet talks back. Half your cash is gone before you blink.

events.title: Miracle flip
events.body: You flip a miracle wristband for straight cash. Capitalism, but make it tie-dye.

events.title: Lot dogs
events.body: Someone's grilling lot dogs and you trade stickers for a bag of food. Peak nutrition.

events.title: Bathroom deal
events.body: A bathroom line deal goes weirdly right. You walk away with substances and no regrets. Yet.

events.title: Overpay tabs
events.body: You bought tabs from a guy who was also a cop's nephew. Allegedly. Your cash evaporates.

events.title: Quiet hustle
events.body: You hustled the lot in silence. Nothing dramatic. Vibes were mid. Onward.
